title: Integrated Analysis and Collaboration Tool: a platform for medical image analysis and coordinated collaboration using AI and open-source technologies
summary:
Within this project, pseudonymized imaging data are further processed in order to train an AI platform that is being developed as part of the collaborative project InterACT.

The data used originate from routine clinical examinations and treatments at the Hand und Fußzentrum (HFZ) Berlin. These examinations were performed independently of the project described here and are not directly related to this study.

Specifically, X-ray images of magnesium implants acquired at various time points after surgery are used. The images are initially manually evaluated by employees of Medical Magnesium by labeling (segmenting) bone, implant degradation products, and the metallic implant itself.

Subsequently, the same images are automatically segmented by the AI system. If the AI results deviate from the manual evaluation (for example by more than 5%), the AI results are reviewed and corrected accordingly. These corrected data are used for further training and improvement of the AI platform.
conditions: Data from patients who received one or more magnesium implants as part of routine clinical treatment are used.

Inclusion criteria:
Only data from patients who are at least 18 years old, have received one or more magnesium implants as part of regular treatment, and have signed an informed consent form for the further use of their data will be used. There are no other inclusion or exclusion criteria.
